kinds.read: Read-only diagnostic. Runs automatically, including when the AI asks for it.
kinds.change: Changes the laptop. Always needs the technician's approval.
kinds.stress: Load test that uses CPU, RAM, disk or network heavily. Always needs approval.
kinds.shell: Raw command. Only when ALLOW_REMOTE_SHELL=true on the server, and always needs approval.

tools.name: system_profile
tools.title: System profile
tools.description: OS, build, CPU model, RAM, disks, uptime, manufacturer/model/serial, admin rights and whether a reboot is pending.

tools.name: top_processes
tools.title: Top processes
tools.description: Processes using the most CPU or memory, sampled over a few seconds.

tools.name: browser_memory
tools.title: Browser memory
tools.description: Groups Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Opera and Safari processes; total RAM per browser, renderer/tab process counts and the heaviest child processes.

tools.name: disk_usage
tools.title: Disk usage
tools.description: Every mounted volume with total, used and free space in bytes and percent.

tools.name: largest_folders
tools.title: Largest folders
tools.description: Sizes of the sub-folders of a path, biggest first. Defaults to the user's home folder. Time-limited scan.

path.description: Folder to scan. Empty means the user's home folder.

tools.name: largest_files
tools.title: Largest files
tools.description: Biggest files under a path (default home folder) above a minimum size. Time-limited scan.

path.description: Folder to scan. Empty means the user's home folder.

tools.name: storage_snapshot
tools.title: Storage snapshot (spike finder)
tools.description: Measures well-known folders (temp, downloads, caches, app data, update cache, dumps). The server compares it with the previous snapshot to show what grew.

tools.name: cleanup_candidates
tools.title: Cleanup candidates
tools.description: Reclaimable space: temp folders, browser caches, recycle bin/trash, Windows Update cache, crash dumps, Windows.old, hiberfil/pagefile size.

tools.name: cpu_spike_watch
tools.title: CPU spike watch
tools.description: Samples CPU every second for N seconds and records which processes caused spikes above 80%.

tools.name: hang_and_crash_events
tools.title: Hangs, crashes and BSODs
tools.description: Application hangs/crashes, unexpected shutdowns, blue screens (minidumps), WHEA hardware errors, disk errors, kernel OOM/hung tasks and crash reports.

tools.name: not_responding
tools.title: Not-responding processes
tools.description: Windows apps marked Not Responding; on Linux/macOS processes stuck in uninterruptible disk wait or zombies.

tools.name: os_integrity_check
tools.title: OS integrity check
tools.description: Windows: DISM CheckHealth/ScanHealth, CBS log corruption summary, optional SFC verify. Linux: package audit and failed services. macOS: SIP and volume status.

deep.description: Windows: also run DISM ScanHealth and sfc /verifyonly (10-20 minutes).

tools.name: installed_apps
tools.title: Installed apps (incl. hidden/orphaned)
tools.description: All installed apps from every uninstall registry key plus Store apps on Windows; flags apps hidden from Control Panel and orphaned entries whose files are gone. Linux: dpkg/rpm/snap/flatpak. macOS: /Applications and Homebrew.

tools.name: uninstall_leftovers
tools.title: Find app leftovers
tools.description: Searches for folders, registry keys, services, scheduled tasks and shortcuts left behind by an app (for apps that will not uninstall or keep coming back).

tools.name: pending_updates
tools.title: Pending updates
tools.description: Available OS updates, last successful update and whether a reboot is required.

tools.name: startup_items
tools.title: Startup items
tools.description: Programs that start at logon (Run keys, Startup folders, autostart entries, LaunchAgents).

tools.name: services
tools.title: Services
tools.description: System services with state and start type.

tools.name: driver_problems
tools.title: Driver problems
tools.description: Devices with driver errors (Device Manager yellow bang) or kernel driver/firmware errors.

tools.name: disk_health
tools.title: Disk health (SMART)
tools.description: Physical disk health status, wear, temperature and read/write error counters.

tools.name: battery_health
tools.title: Battery health
tools.description: Charge, design vs full-charge capacity (wear %), cycle count.

tools.name: network_check
tools.title: Network check
tools.description: Adapters, default gateway, ping to gateway and internet, DNS resolution and latency to this server.

tools.name: temperatures
tools.title: Temperatures and clocks
tools.description: CPU/thermal-zone temperatures, fan speeds and current vs max CPU clock (throttling hint).

tools.name: event_log_summary
tools.title: Event log summary
tools.description: Recent warning/error/critical OS log entries.

tools.name: security_status
tools.title: Security status
tools.description: Firewall, antivirus, disk encryption, patch status and listening ports.

tools.name: kill_process
tools.title: End process
tools.description: Ends a process by PID or by name (all matching processes). Unsaved work in that app is lost.

tools.name: service_control
tools.title: Start/stop/restart service
tools.description: Starts, stops or restarts a system service.

tools.name: disable_startup_item
tools.title: Disable startup item
tools.description: Stops an item from running at logon. The original entry is backed up so it can be restored.

tools.name: enable_startup_item
tools.title: Re-enable startup item
tools.description: Restores a previously disabled logon item from its backup.

tools.name: list_backups
tools.title: List backups (undo)
tools.description: Reversible actions this agent has recorded: quarantined app folders, exported registry entries and disabled startup items, and whether each can still be restored.

tools.name: restore_backup
tools.title: Restore / undo
tools.description: Undoes a recorded action by its backup id: moves a quarantined folder back, re-imports an exported registry entry, or re-enables a startup item.

tools.name: clean_junk
tools.title: Clean junk files
tools.description: Deletes temporary files, browser caches, recycle bin/trash, Windows Update download cache, thumbnail cache or crash dumps. Files in use are skipped.

tools.name: repair_os
tools.title: Repair OS
tools.description: Windows: sfc /scannow, DISM RestoreHealth, DISM StartComponentCleanup or chkdsk online scan. Linux: dpkg --configure -a / apt-get -f install. macOS: diskutil verifyVolume.

tools.name: uninstall_app
tools.title: Uninstall app (incl. force)
tools.description: Uninstalls an app found by installed_apps. mode=force also removes stubborn apps: silent uninstaller, msiexec, then ends its processes, quarantines its folder and removes its registry entry (backed up).

tools.name: remove_app_entry
tools.title: Remove orphaned app entry
tools.description: Windows: deletes a broken/orphaned uninstall registry entry (exported to a .reg backup first) so it disappears from Apps & Features.

tools.name: install_updates
tools.title: Install updates
tools.description: Downloads and installs available OS updates (Windows Update API, apt/dnf, softwareupdate). May need a reboot afterwards.

tools.name: network_repair
tools.title: Network repair
tools.description: Flush DNS, renew DHCP lease, reset Winsock or TCP/IP stack (the last two need a reboot).

tools.name: create_restore_point
tools.title: Create restore point
tools.description: Creates a Windows System Restore point before risky changes.

tools.name: schedule_reboot
tools.title: Reboot
tools.description: Restarts the laptop after a delay (the user sees a warning). The agent reconnects after boot only in persistent mode.

tools.name: stress_cpu
tools.title: CPU stress test
tools.description: Loads all (or N) CPU cores and records load, clock speed and temperature every second to reveal throttling or instability. Auto-stops on overheating.

tools.name: stress_ram
tools.title: RAM stress test
tools.description: Allocates a share of free RAM, writes and verifies patterns repeatedly and reports any mismatches (possible faulty RAM) and allocation speed.

tools.name: stress_disk
tools.title: Disk benchmark
tools.description: Writes and reads a temporary file: sequential MB/s and random 4K IOPS. The file is deleted afterwards.

tools.name: network_speed
tools.title: Network speed to server
tools.description: Measures download and upload throughput and latency between the laptop and this server over the LAN.

tools.name: run_shell
tools.title: Run command
tools.description: Runs a raw command (PowerShell, cmd or sh). Disabled unless ALLOW_REMOTE_SHELL=true on the server.
